zh-CN.title: 桌面录音体验统一
items: 欢迎语与群发使用和聊天相同的桌面录音浮层，支持停止、试听和发送

en.title: Unified desktop voice recording
items: Welcome and broadcast editors share chat's desktop recording studio with stop, preview, and send controls
Keep the text editor visible while recording, without clipped voice controls
